environment: Windows 11 Pro x64, MSVC 19.51, GNS 1.6.1 and OpenSSL 3.6.5 via vcpkg 65a2c23, loopback; real time
game_exe_sha256: N/A (prototype does not touch the game)
objective: Implement ChatGPT review #12 (FB-12-01..05) on feature/review12-retry-experiment: a predeclared one-variable experiment on the session reconnect retry, KI-40 lifecycle diagnosis, the GNS return-routability question, more departure tests, then the full v6 battery with seeded repeats.
hypothesis: A shorter session reconnect retry (250 ms instead of 500 ms) lowers the harsh secure recovery tail on both transports without new gate failures; KI-40 reproduces under repetition and the lifecycle trace localizes it.
procedure: Added per-attempt ConnectRequest logging, --reconnect-retry-ms and soak.ps1 -ReconnectRetryMs; documented the experiment and its decision rule in docs/soak-testing.md and committed tools/soak/compare_arms.py with self-tests before the first run. Ran 2 arms x 2 profiles (harsh gns/udp secure) x 5 UDP seed bases (200..240), interleaved, on build 849a745. Then the test-runner lifecycle trace (MORDOR_LIFECYCLE_LOG), a GNS lifecycle test, departure tests, F-GNS-001 from a read-only GNS v1.6.1 clone, cookie cost in the timeline, a non-fatal soak warm-up. Battery on 2f2fe20 in isolated processes: suites x2 on both builds, E2E, asymmetric x4, secure E2E x4, 12 x 120 s v6 soaks plus 4 seeded repeats per harsh secure profile. Then the KI-40 repro: 12 x network-gns and 6 x integration-gns under a dump-writing watcher, and 5 abrupt plus 5 orderly host/client sessions.
expected_result: B adopted by the predeclared rule; all suites pass; the battery passes; KI-40 reproduced and localized.
observed_result: Experiment (compare_arms.py, rule as predeclared): harsh-gns-secure A 500 ms n=4 (1 aborted after warm-up) median 2726 max 3890 ms, 2 over 3000; B 250 ms n=5 median 3282 max 4752, 3 over 3000. harsh-udp-secure A n=5 median 2330 max 3358, 1 over; B n=5 median 1163 max 2447, 0 over. No other gate failures in either arm; realized delivery 0.83-0.85 and RTT p50 188-206 ms comparable. Verdict: keep A (B fails the rule on GNS though it strongly helps UDP). Suites x2 on both builds all passed: dtls 56, integration 53, integration-gns 38 + 15 skipped, network 17, network-gns 12 + 5 skipped, transport 18, transport-both 21, unit 17, gns 7; E2E, asymmetric 4/4, secure E2E 4/4 passed. Battery after the changes: 20/20 (12 scenarios + 8 seeded repeats; harsh-gns-secure 2560, 2820, 2082, 1380, 2276 ms; harsh-udp-secure 1673, 2906, 2387, 1847, 1921 ms). Not evidence of a fix: pooled over all default-policy 120 s runs since 4cf1935 the recovery gate failed 4/14 harsh-gns-secure and 2/15 harsh-udp-secure. Cookie exchange 181-923 ms per harsh reconnect (median about 300 ms over the final battery's 10 harsh secure runs). F-GNS-001: GNS v1.6.1 direct UDP requires a stateless address-bound challenge before a connection exists. KI-40 not reproduced: 18 GNS test runs and both battery passes exited normally; all 18 lifecycle traces reached atexit with 0 GNS connections and 0 listen sockets at main return; 10 host/client sessions (5 abrupt client kills, 5 orderly) ended with the host exiting by itself with code 0. Incidents: the first battery attempt was contaminated by MORDOR_TRANSPORT left by a failed script in the same process and was stopped while still building, before producing any result, and restarted with each step in its own process; a second soak (192116) stopped right after its warm-up, kept without summary; the warm-up now captures stderr and cannot abort a soak.
errors: Predeclared hypothesis rejected for GNS (B not adopted); KI-35 still about 29%/13% failure on harsh secure; KI-40 not reproduced, so not diagnosed; one experiment run aborted after warm-up; the KI-40 repro script recorded no exit codes for the test runs (handle not cached; hang detection unaffected). Correction after review of PR #13: the GNS fields in the 'atexit' lifecycle lines were reads of already-destroyed static state (undefined behaviour); only the main_returning values are valid, and the runner now logs no GNS state at atexit.
follow_up: KI-35: a transport-specific retry, or removing the redundant cookie round trip on GNS (F-GNS-001), each only as a new predeclared experiment; owner approval for a debugger to symbolize any KI-40 dump; KI-28b; LAN test; external review.
